open_points.subject: public_op:runtime_settings.load_runtime_settings — port validation
open_points.text: every value has the form its row of the start-up table declares.
open_points.question: Must a port that parses as an integer but lies outside 1 to 65535 end the start, as A8 requires, or does its integer form suffice?
options: End the start for every port outside 1 to 65535.
Accept any value having integer form, including values outside the range.
open_points.default_guess: End the start for every port outside 1 to 65535.

witness.initial: All required environment variables are present and otherwise valid; PORTAL_DELIVERER_PORT is 70000.
events: module:runtime_settings reads and parses PORTAL_DELIVERER_PORT as an integer.
outcomes: A8's range rule ends the start without listening.
The State 5 form-only reading accepts 70000 and the start continues until this value is used.
witness.observer: The deployment operator sees whether the service reaches listening or the start ends.

open_points.subject: public_op:runtime_settings.load_runtime_settings — timezone validation
open_points.text: A missing required setting or a value of the wrong form ends the start.
open_points.question: Must a syntactically valid string naming no known time zone end the start, as A8 requires, or is it accepted because its form is str?
options: End the start when the time zone database does not know the value.
Accept every string and defer discovery of an unknown zone until later use.
open_points.default_guess: End the start when the time zone database does not know the value.

witness.initial: All required environment variables are present and otherwise valid; PORTAL_DELIVERER_TIMEZONE names a time zone absent from the time zone database.
events: module:runtime_settings reads the timezone value as a string.
outcomes: A8 ends the start because the time zone database does not know the value.
The State 5 wrong-form-only reading accepts the string and returns run settings.
witness.observer: The deployment operator sees whether startup rejects the configuration.

open_points.subject: public_op:runtime_settings.load_runtime_settings — integer environment-variable syntax
open_points.text: every value has the form its row of the start-up table declares.
open_points.question: Which textual representations of the int-valued PORTAL_DELIVERER_PORT environment variable have the declared form?
options: Accept only one or more ASCII decimal digits, then apply the 1-to-65535 range check.
Use the implementation language's ordinary integer parser, potentially accepting surrounding whitespace, a sign, or non-ASCII decimal digits.
open_points.default_guess: Accept only ASCII decimal digits with no sign or whitespace, then require a value from 1 to 65535.

witness.initial: All settings are valid except PORTAL_DELIVERER_PORT is written as +8850.
events: module:runtime_settings reads the textual environment value +8850.
outcomes: A strict decimal grammar treats +8850 as the wrong form and ends the start.
An ordinary integer parser produces 8850 and startup continues.
witness.observer: The deployment operator sees whether the same environment configuration starts the service.
